# Sarkari Yojana

> Sarkari Yojana (sarkariyojanasetu.com) is an independent citizen-information platform providing simplified information, eligibility rules, and application guidance for Indian government social welfare schemes (Central and State).

## Key Pages
- [Schemes Directory](/yojna): Comprehensive list of all verified government schemes, their benefits, and rules.
- [Guides](/guide): In-depth walkthroughs on safe applications and necessary documents.
- [Eligibility Checker](/mere-liye): A demographic-based tool to find schemes tailored to individual users.
- [Status Check](/status-directory): Official portal links to check application status or beneficiary lists.
